svg.aria-label: design: Design from references, scored by a critic. Three sub-skills: core, flow, banner-design. Steps: core, principles, taste, a scored loop; flow, Figma screens with their flow; banner-design, brand side, four jobs, a CTA; bench, crop, contrast, phone-width checks. Output: a design that passes the critic and the bench, not the author.
